What TrueVault will not do

TrueVault does not clone apps, run them from inside itself, or hide them behind a fake icon. Apps that claim to do that need root or break on the next Android update. Isolating an app is something Android itself has to provide.

Private Space is locked
Unlock it through Android to view or open private apps. While it is locked, its apps are not running and TrueVault will not list them.
Your device policy blocks this
This device is managed, and its policy does not allow additional profiles. Private Space cannot be set up here, by TrueVault or by anything else.
Listing private apps needs the Home role
Android only lets the default Home app see other profiles. You can enable Secure Launcher Mode in Settings → Advanced Privacy, or keep using Private Space directly from Android.
Android did not grant TrueVault permission to read profile state on this device.
Not available on this Android version
Private app isolation is not built into this Android version. TrueVault can still fully protect your files — the vault, scanner and backup all work exactly the same.
A work profile is present
A work profile is managed by your organisation, not by you, and it is not a private space. Its administrator can control data inside it. TrueVault keeps personal and work vaults completely separate.
Your file vault works fully whether or not any of this is available.
Your phone may include additional app privacy tools
Availability and behaviour depend on your phone manufacturer. TrueVault cannot manage files or apps inside those external spaces, and it never reads what is in them.
